body.text: OramaVR is a virtual reality company that offers immersive, interactive training simulations for medical and surgical education. It uses advanced VR technology to enhance learning outcomes, reduce training costs, and improve patient safety through realistic practice environments.

I joined ORamaVR in late 2019, initially working as a 3D Designer and VR Content Developer. Later, in my roles as 3D Technical Director and Head of Design, I have been responsible for supervising the 3D Content Pipeline as well as working closely with both the Development and Design Teams. I have now worked on over 30 VR simulations.

body.text: "The Egg" Virtual Production short film created in 2024.

The shootings took place in August 2024 at Base.M studio in Aalborg University Copenhagen as part of the MSc thesis "Luminating Scenes: A study of Light Automation in Virtual Production environments".

The short film is called “Το αυγό”; Greek for “The Egg”. The film is a remake of an iconic scene from the Greek short film series Ekeinos kai Ekeinos (Him and the Other), released in 1972, which marked a pivotal moment in Greek cinema, written by Kostas Mourselas.

title: Digital Media Research
label: Virtual Production Research
subtitle: A study of Light Automation using Deep Learning in Virtual Production Environments
tools: UE5, BMPCC4K, Autodesk Maya, Polyscan, C++, Overleaf, Python 3.1, VS Code, Elgato Cam-Link

body.text: Automatic Digital lighting adaptation for Virtual Production.

This study introduces a deep learning–based tool that automates lighting in Virtual Production to reduce complexity and improve communication between Directors of Photography and the Virtual Art Department in Unreal Engine 5. Focus-group interviews with ten VP workshop participants revealed that lighting limitations on VP stages create a steep learning curve and hinder collaboration. To address this, three models were developed to predict light position, light color, or both from an input image, with emphasis on the color prediction model due to easier validation. The tool’s impact is evaluated through the production of a short film, demonstrating its potential to streamline VP lighting workflows.
Check out an overview of the project here: https://drive.proton.me/urls/6RXZ69ZEBW#w1yqe4hUOiD2

body.text: Blurspot Films was created by a bunch of creative techies in order to bring their dreams to life.

Blurspot Films was created by Nick Pattas and Achilleas Apostolou in 2021 in Heraklion, Crete as a continuation of their first filmmaking projects: Déjà Rêvé (2019) and Pythmenas (2020). Blurspot is now based in Athens after the addition of Vasilis Tsimitras to the team.
